title: 第十五章 古籍库星图残影第十六章 失窃的星图碎片
lines: 第十五章：古籍库星图残影
幻境学院的古籍库藏在主教学楼西侧的石砌塔楼里，外墙爬满了会随魔法波动变换颜色的“流光藤”。此刻是傍晚，藤蔓正从金紫色褪成暗蓝，像给塔楼裹上了一层渐变色的绒布。林澈站在塔楼下，仰头望着那扇嵌在十二米高处的拱形窗——据说古籍库的核心区域就在那扇窗后，存放着学院最古老的一批文献。
“你确定要进去？”身后传来苏璃的声音，她抱着一本《灵植与魔法共鸣手册》，淡绿色的裙摆在晚风里轻轻晃动，“古籍库的门禁是‘知识契约’魔法，没得到导师许可擅自进入，会被藤蔓缠住至少三个小时。”
林澈指尖无意识地摩挲着袖口，那里还残留着上午实战考核时留下的空间波动痕迹。“上午考核时，我的感知突然失控了，”他低声说，“就像……有什么东西在强行拉着我的意识往某个方向走，最后停在了这栋塔楼附近。”
凯靠在不远处的梧桐树上，指尖把玩着一小簇跳动的火焰。“空间感知者的直觉？听起来比学院那些老古董的占卜靠谱多了。”他嗤笑一声，视线扫过塔楼紧闭的大门，“不过我得提醒你，上周有个魔法国的高年级生想闯进去偷《上古烈焰咒》，结果被流光藤捆成了粽子，挂在塔顶晒了整整一夜。”
月姬没说话，只是微微歪着头，目光落在塔楼墙壁的阴影处。她的瞳孔里偶尔会闪过细碎的光斑，像是有什么东西在镜片般的眼底折射、碎裂。“那里……”她忽然抬手，指向塔楼西侧一块不起眼的石壁，“有光。”
三人顺着她指的方向看去，只见石壁上布满了青苔，只有在晚风掀起落叶的瞬间，才能隐约看到一丝极淡的银辉，像月光被石头吸进去后，又挣扎着透出来的残影。
“看来不需要硬闯大门了。”林澈的指尖泛起淡淡的银色光晕，那是他调动空间感知时的征兆。随着他的气息流转，石壁上的青苔像是被无形的手拨开，露出了后面一块刻着复杂纹路的石板——纹路构成的图案，像极了学院徽章上那半轮被云雾遮挡的月亮。
“是‘月引纹’，”苏璃凑近看了看，轻声道，“灵都国的古籍里提过，这是上古时期用来标记秘密入口的符文，需要moonlight（月光）和精神力共鸣才能开启。”她抬手，掌心凝聚起一团柔和的绿色光芒，那是她与植物沟通时常用的治愈能量，此刻却像萤火虫般飞向石板上的纹路。
绿光撞上银纹的瞬间，石板发出了低沉的嗡鸣，纹路像活过来似的亮起，顺着固定的轨迹游走，最终在中央拼出了一个完整的圆月图案。石板缓缓向内滑开，露出了一条仅容一人通过的狭窄通道，通道两侧的石壁上嵌着会发光的萤石，照亮了通往上层的旋转楼梯。
“看来学院的老古董们也不是完全守旧。”凯收起火焰，率先走了进去，“至少没把路堵死。”
通道里弥漫着陈旧纸张和灰尘的味道，混合着一种类似潮湿泥土的气息。月姬走在最后，经过石板时，她下意识地伸手碰了碰那些逐渐暗下去的纹路，指尖刚触碰到石面，瞳孔里突然闪过一串快速流动的画面——破碎的星图、燃烧的城池、一个戴着银色面具的人影在月光下转身，面具上的裂痕像极了此刻石板上的纹路。
“月姬？”林澈回头看她，“怎么了？”
“没什么。”月姬收回手，眼底的光斑迅速褪去，“只是觉得……这纹路有点眼熟。”
四人顺着旋转楼梯往上走，萤石的光芒在墙壁上投下晃动的影子，像有无数双眼睛在暗中窥视。越往上走，空气中的魔法波动越清晰，林澈的感知变得异常敏锐，他能“看”到那些隐藏在墙壁里的魔法阵——它们像一张细密的网，笼罩着整个塔楼，却在靠近某个区域时出现了一丝极细微的缝隙。
“就在前面。”他停下脚步，指向楼梯尽头的一扇木门，“我的感知在这里最强烈，就像……有什么东西在和我的意识产生共鸣。”
木门没有锁，轻轻一推就开了。门后是一间比想象中更小的房间，大约只有二十平米，四壁摆满了高大的书架，书架上整齐地摆放着用兽皮和金属片装订的古籍，封面上的文字大多已经模糊不清。房间中央有一张巨大的石桌，桌面上刻着一个复杂的星图轮廓，只是轮廓的中心位置空荡荡的，像是被人硬生生挖走了一块。
“这里就是古籍库的核心区？”凯皱眉，“看起来还没我们宿舍的储藏室大。”
“重点不在大小。”苏璃走到石桌前，指尖拂过桌面上的星图刻痕，“这些刻痕里残留着很强的空间魔法气息，而且……”她顿了顿，声音压低，“是被强行抹去的痕迹。”
林澈的注意力却不在星图上。他的目光被石桌旁一个半开的金属盒子吸引了——盒子是暗金色的，表面刻着和塔楼外石板上相似的月引纹，此刻正有微弱的银光从盒缝里渗出来。
他走过去，小心翼翼地打开盒子。里面没有古籍，也没有魔法道具，只有一层铺着深蓝色丝绒的凹槽，凹槽的形状与石桌上星图缺失的部分完全吻合。而在丝绒上，残留着一道若隐若现的光影——那光影缓缓流转，勾勒出无数星辰的轨迹，最终汇聚成一幅完整的星图，星图的边缘标注着几个模糊的古文字，像是坐标，又像是某种咒语。
“这是……星图的残影？”苏璃惊讶地睁大了眼睛，“空间魔法里的‘记忆留影’？只有承载过极强精神力的物品，才能在原物被取走后留下这种痕迹。”
林澈的指尖轻轻悬在残影上方，没有触碰，却能清晰地感受到一股熟悉的力量——那股在上午考核时拉扯他意识的力量，此刻正从残影中源源不断地散发出来。随着他的气息靠近，残影的光芒突然变得明亮，星图上的星辰开始旋转，像活过来的星系，其中一颗最亮的星辰闪烁了三下，然后朝着房间东北方向的书架飞去，最终化作一道微光，钻进了书架最上层的一本黑色封皮古籍里。
“它在指引方向？”凯挑眉，几步走到那个书架前，伸手取下了那本黑色古籍。古籍异常沉重，封面上没有任何文字，只有一个用银线绣成的眼睛图案，眼睛的瞳孔处镶嵌着一颗小小的蓝宝石，此刻正微微发亮。
他刚把古籍拿到手里，整个房间突然剧烈地震动起来，石壁上的萤石光芒忽明忽暗，书架上的古籍哗啦啦地掉落，发出刺耳的声响。
“怎么回事？”苏璃扶住摇晃的石桌，绿色的光芒在她周身亮起，形成一道保护屏障。
“是‘知识契约’的警报！”月姬的声音带着一丝急促，她指着石桌中央的星图残影，“残影的能量太强，触发了古籍库的防御魔法！”
只见石桌表面的刻痕突然亮起红光，那些红光顺着地面蔓延，迅速形成一个巨大的魔法阵，阵法的边缘开始冒出黑色的雾气，雾气中隐约传来藤蔓生长的嘶嘶声——是流光藤！它们竟然穿透了石壁，从四面八方朝着房间里涌来！
“该死，被缠住就麻烦了！”凯低骂一声，将黑色古籍塞进怀里，挥手放出火焰，试图阻挡雾气，“林澈，你的空间感知能不能打开通道？”
林澈没有回答，他的全部注意力都集中在那本黑色古籍上。就在凯碰到古籍的瞬间，他的感知突然再次失控，但这一次不再是被拉扯，而是像沉入了一片冰冷的深海——他“看”到了无数破碎的画面：戴着银色面具的人将星图放进金属盒，星图上的星辰突然爆裂，化作无数光点散落向大地，其中一个光点坠落在斯卡市的方向，也就是幻境学院的位置……
“林澈！”苏璃的呼喊将他拉回现实，黑色的雾气已经逼近，流光藤的尖刺在萤石光下闪着寒光。
“这边！”林澈猛地回神，指尖爆发出强烈的银色光芒，他朝着房间西北角的墙壁挥手，空间像被打碎的玻璃般出现了一道扭曲的裂隙，“从这里走，快！”
凯率先冲进裂隙，苏璃紧随其后。月姬在进入裂隙前，回头看了一眼石桌上的星图残影——那残影正在红光的侵蚀下逐渐消散，只剩下最后一颗星辰的光影，那颗星辰的位置，恰好对应着镜幻国的方向。她瞳孔一缩，下意识地记住了那个位置，然后转身跃入裂隙。
林澈最后一个离开，在他钻进裂隙的瞬间，他听到身后传来一声沉闷的巨响，似乎是那本黑色古籍从凯的怀里掉了出来，砸在了石桌上。但他没有时间回头，空间裂隙在他身后迅速闭合，将古籍库的震动和雾气彻底隔绝。
再次站稳时，四人已经身处学院西侧的小树林里，晚风吹过树叶，发出沙沙的声响，仿佛刚才的一切只是幻觉。
“呼……差点被当成偷书贼挂在塔顶。”凯拍着胸口，伸手摸向怀里，脸色突然一变，“古籍呢？！”
他的怀里空空如也，那本黑色封皮的古籍不见了。
“掉在里面了？”苏璃蹙眉，“可刚才的震动那么厉害，说不定已经被流光藤缠住了。”
林澈没有说话，他闭着眼，试图再次调动空间感知寻找古籍的位置，但脑海里只剩下一片混乱的星图残影，以及那个戴着银色面具的模糊人影。
“不管怎样，”他睁开眼，看向同伴们，“那本古籍，还有星图，一定和秘境有关。我们必须找到它们。”
夜色渐深，流光藤缠绕的塔楼在月光下沉默矗立，仿佛在守护着某个即将被揭开的秘密。而林澈四人不知道的是，他们刚才的一举一动，都被隐藏在塔楼顶端的一双眼睛，看得清清楚楚。

Chapter 15: Afterimages of the Star Map in the Ancient Book Library
The ancient book library of Illusion Academy is hidden in the stone tower on the west side of the main teaching building. The outer walls are covered with "streaming vines" that change colors with the fluctuation of magic. It's evening now, and the vines are fading from golden purple to dark blue, like a layer of gradient velvet wrapping the tower. Lin Che stood under the tower, looking up at the arched window embedded at a height of twelve meters - it is said that the core area of ​​the ancient book library is behind that window, where the oldest documents of the academy are stored.
"Are you sure you want to go in?" Su Li's voice came from behind. She was holding a "Handbook of Spiritual Plants and Magic Resonance", her light green skirt swaying gently in the evening breeze. "The access control of the ancient book library is the 'Knowledge Contract' magic. If you enter without the permission of your instructor, you will be entangled in vines for at least three hours."
Lin Che's fingertips unconsciously rubbed the cuffs, where there were still traces of spatial fluctuations left during the morning's actual combat assessment. "During the assessment in the morning, my perception suddenly went out of control," he whispered. "It was like... something was forcibly pulling my consciousness in a certain direction, and finally stopped near this tower."
Kai leaned against the sycamore tree not far away, playing with a small cluster of dancing flames with his fingertips. "The intuition of a space perceiver? It sounds much more reliable than the ancient divination of the academy." He sneered and glanced at the closed door of the tower. "But I have to remind you that last week, a senior student from the Magic Kingdom tried to break in and steal the "Ancient Flame Curse". As a result, he was tied into a rice dumpling by the flowing vines and hung on the top of the tower to dry in the sun all night."
Yue Ji didn't speak, but tilted her head slightly, her eyes falling on the shadow of the tower wall. Occasionally, tiny spots of light would flash in her pupils, as if something was refracting and shattering under the lens-like eyes. "There..." She suddenly raised her hand and pointed to an inconspicuous stone wall on the west side of the tower, "There is light."
The three of them looked in the direction she pointed, and saw that the stone wall was covered with moss. Only when the evening breeze stirred up the fallen leaves, could they vaguely see a faint silver glow, like the afterimage of the moonlight being sucked into the stone and then struggling to shine through.
"It seems that there is no need to forcefully break through the door." Lin Che's fingertips glowed with a faint silver halo, which was a sign that he was mobilizing his space perception. As his breath flowed, the moss on the stone wall seemed to be pushed aside by invisible hands, revealing a stone slab with complex patterns carved on the back - the pattern formed by the patterns was very similar to the half-moon obscured by clouds and mist on the college badge.
"It's the 'Moon Lead Pattern'," Su Li looked closer and whispered. "It is mentioned in the ancient books of Lingdu Kingdom that this is a rune used to mark secret entrances in ancient times. It requires moonlight and spiritual power to resonate to open it." She raised her hand, and a soft green light condensed in the palm of her hand. It was the healing energy she often used when communicating with plants. At this moment, it flew towards the patterns on the stone slab like fireflies.
The moment the green light hit the silver pattern, the stone slab made a low hum, and the pattern lit up as if it came alive, traveling along a fixed trajectory, and finally spelled out a complete full moon pattern in the center. The stone slab slowly slid inward, revealing a narrow passage that only allowed one person to pass. The stone walls on both sides of the passage were embedded with luminous fluorite, illuminating the spiral staircase leading to the upper floor.
"It seems that the old antiques in the academy are not completely conservative." Kai put away the flame and walked in first. "At least the road was not blocked."
The passage smelled of old paper and dust, mixed with a smell similar to damp earth. Yue Ji walked at the end. As she passed the stone slab, she subconsciously reached out and touched the gradually darkening lines. As soon as her fingertips touched the stone surface, a series of fast-moving images suddenly flashed through her pupils - a broken star map, a burning city, and a figure wearing a silver mask turning around in the moonlight. The cracks on the mask were very much like the lines on the stone slab at this moment.
"Yue Ji?" Lin Che looked back at her, "What's wrong?"
"It's nothing." Yue Ji retracted her hand, and the light spots in her eyes quickly faded, "I just feel...the lines look a bit familiar."
The four of them walked up the spiral staircase. The light of fluorite cast shaking shadows on the wall, like countless pairs of eyes peering in the dark. The higher he went, the clearer the magic fluctuations in the air became, and Lin Che's perception became extremely sharp. He could "see" the magic arrays hidden in the walls - they were like a fine net, covering the entire tower, but when approaching a certain area, a tiny gap appeared.
"Right in front." He stopped and pointed to a wooden door at the end of the stairs. "My perception is strongest here, like... something is resonating with my consciousness."
The wooden door was unlocked and opened with a slight push. Behind the door is a smaller room than expected, only about twenty square meters. The walls are lined with tall bookshelves. Ancient books bound with animal skins and metal sheets are neatly placed on the bookshelves. Most of the words on the covers are blurred. There is a huge stone table in the center of the room, with a complex star map outline engraved on the table, but the center of the outline is empty, as if a piece of it has been taken away.
"Is this the core area of the ancient book library?" Kai frowned, "It doesn't look as big as the storage room in our dormitory."
"The important thing is not the size." Su Li walked to the stone table and brushed her fingertips over the star map carvings on the table. "These carvings contain a strong aura of space magic, and..." She paused and lowered her voice, "They are traces of being forcibly erased."
Lin Che's attention was not on the star map. His eyes were attracted by a half-open metal box next to the stone table - the box was dark gold, with a moon pattern similar to that on the stone slab outside the tower engraved on the surface. At this moment, a faint silver light was seeping out from the cracks in the box.
He walked over and carefully opened the box. There are no ancient books or magic props inside, only a layer of grooves covered with dark blue velvet. The shape of the grooves exactly matches the missing part of the star map on the stone table. And on the velvet, a faint light and shadow remained - the light and shadow slowly flowed, outlining the trajectories of countless stars, and finally converged into a complete star map. The edges of the star map were marked with several vague ancient characters, like coordinates or some kind of spell.
"This is... the afterimage of the star map?" Su Li's eyes widened in surprise, "The 'memory image' in space magic? Only items that have carried extremely strong spiritual power can leave such traces after the original item is taken away."
Lin Che's fingertips hovered slightly above the afterimage without touching it, but she could clearly feel a familiar force - the force that pulled at his consciousness during the morning assessment was now being continuously radiated from the afterimage. As his breath came closer, the light of the afterimage suddenly became brighter, and the stars on the star map began to rotate, like a galaxy coming to life. One of the brightest stars flashed three times, and then flew towards the bookshelf in the northeast of the room. Finally, it turned into a faint light and penetrated into an ancient book with a black cover on the top shelf.
"Is it guiding the direction?" Kai raised his eyebrows, walked to the bookshelf in a few steps, reached out and took down the black ancient book. The ancient book was extremely heavy. There was no text on the cover, only an eye pattern embroidered with silver thread. The pupil of the eye was inlaid with a small sapphire, which was shining slightly at the moment.
As soon as he took the ancient book into his hands, the whole room suddenly shook violently. The fluorite light on the stone wall flickered on and off, and the ancient books on the bookshelf fell with a loud crash.
"What's going on?" Su Li held onto the swaying stone table, and green light lit up around her, forming a protective barrier.
"It's the 'Knowledge Contract' alarm!" Yue Ji's voice was a little urgent. She pointed at the afterimage of the star map in the center of the stone table, "The energy of the afterimage is too strong, triggering the defensive magic of the ancient book library!"
The carvings on the surface of the stone table suddenly lit up with red light. The red light spread along the ground and quickly formed a huge magic circle. Black mist began to emerge from the edge of the formation, and the hissing sound of growing vines could be heard faintly in the mist - it was the Luminous Vine! They actually penetrated the stone wall and poured into the room from all directions!
"Damn it, it's going to be troublesome if you get entangled!" Kai cursed, stuffed the black ancient book into his arms, waved his hand and released flames, trying to block the mist, "Lin Che, can your spatial perception open the passage?"
Lin Che didn't answer. All his attention was focused on the black ancient book. The moment Kai encountered the ancient book, his perception suddenly lost control again, but this time it was no longer being pulled, but as if he was sinking into a cold deep sea - he "saw" countless broken pictures: the man wearing a silver mask put the star map into a metal box, and the stars on the star map suddenly exploded and turned into countless light spots scattered to the earth. One of the light spots fell in the direction of Ska City, which is the location of the Academy of Illusion...
"Lin Che!" Su Li's shout brought him back to reality. The black mist was approaching, and the spikes of the streamer vine shone coldly under the fluorite light.
"This way!" Lin Che suddenly came back to her senses. Strong silver light erupted from her fingertips. He waved towards the wall in the northwest corner of the room, and a twisted crack appeared in the space like broken glass. "Go from here, quickly!"
Kai rushed into the rift first, followed closely by Su Li. Before entering the crack, Yue Ji looked back at the afterimage of the star map on the stone table - the afterimage was gradually dissipating under the erosion of the red light, leaving only the light and shadow of the last star. The position of that star happened to correspond to the direction of Jinghuan Kingdom. Her pupils shrank, she subconsciously remembered the location, then turned around and jumped into the rift.
Lin Che was the last to leave. The moment he got into the crack, he heard a dull loud noise behind him. It seemed that the black ancient book fell out of Kai's arms and hit the stone table. But he didn't have time to look back. The spatial rift quickly closed behind him, completely isolating the vibrations and fog from the ancient book library.
When they stood firm again, the four of them were already in the small woods on the west side of the college. The evening wind blew through the leaves, making a rustling sound, as if everything just now was just an illusion.
"Huh... I almost got hung up on the top of the tower as a book thief." Kai patted his chest and reached into his arms. His expression suddenly changed, "Where are the ancient books?!"
His arms were empty, and the ancient book with black cover was missing.
"Did it fall inside?" Su Li frowned, "But the vibration just now was so severe, maybe it was entangled in the flowing light vine."
Lin Che did not speak. He closed his eyes and tried to mobilize his spatial perception again to find the location of the ancient book, but in his mind there was only a chaotic afterimage of the star map and the blurry figure wearing a silver mask.
"No matter what," he opened his eyes and looked at his companions, "that ancient book and the star map must be related to the secret realm. We must find them."
As the night gets darker, the tower surrounded by flowing vines stands silently under the moonlight, as if guarding a secret that is about to be revealed. What Lin Che and the others didn't know was that every move they made just now was clearly visible to a pair of eyes hidden at the top of the tower.
